title: Swat Family Escape
summary: Five easy days from Lahore in Swat for families: the chairlift at Malam Jabba, the forests of Kalam and a jeep ride to Mahodand Lake.

image.alt: The green Swat River at Kalam, between pine-covered slopes and a snow-capped peak

overview.headline: Five easy days in Swat, planned around young families
paragraphs: Shorter drives, earlier evenings and hotels with gardens. We start with a night at Malam Jabba, ride the chairlift, then move up the valley to Kalam for two nights by the river.
From Kalam a jeep takes us to Mahodand Lake for the day, and on the way home we stop at the White Palace at Marghazar before a last night in Mingora.
suitedTo: Families with young children and grandparents
First trips north, with no very long road days
Groups who want green valleys rather than high mountains
notSuitedTo: Travellers after high peaks and glaciers (see Hunza or Skardu)
Anyone wanting a fast pace; this trip is deliberately slow
